design: One additional matched blind pair on the same two exposed tasks, baseline commit 4e3c28a versus candidate-v2. Both tasks and grader frozen before runs. New judge without skill versions or earlier comparisons.
why: Initial two pairs showed 0 versus 3 unjustified scenarios, but not overall protection dominance. Concrete shortcut-validation gaps and a representation assumption motivate two narrow instruction additions.
candidate_delta: requirements-tdd: preconditions and effects on shortcut paths; state-machine-verification: only promised representation constraints. Other candidate-v1 instructions unchanged.
scope: Two tasks; 12 original faults plus four prior judge-discovered faults; two original refactors and a separately caveated subclass diagnostic.
no_pooling: Directed debugging after seeing prior outputs, not an independent holdout or confirmation of broad superiority. Report apart from R1/R2.
decision: Retain only a supported bounded improvement; report any remaining misses and do not hide them behind aggregate scores. This is the final directed iteration for this campaign.
